description: A fixed-length dataset whose SYNCHRONIZED items leave bytes no item covers: two runs of slack of different widths, each with items in front of it and behind it. Twenty bytes a record, sixteen of them covered by an item. What a comparison of values can hold a generator to here is each run's width, through a read and through a write -- a dropped run moves the items behind it, and a run handed back at the other run's length is one a writer refuses. That the retained bytes are the same bytes is not something a values document can state; see the corpus README.
